util

Enum Platform

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<Platform>
      • util.Platform
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.io.Serializable, java.lang.Comparable<Platform>

    public enum Platform
extends java.lang.Enum<Platform>
    Defines a mapping of Operating System constants to their human-readable names, kernel versions, and server/workstation classifications.

    This enumeration provides a standardised way to identify Platforms across different families, such as Windows, Linux, Unix, and macOS. It is capable of resolving ambiguities in standard system properties, such as distinguishing between Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016, or detecting specific Linux flavours like CentOS, RHEL, and Ubuntu.

    For Windows, this maps internal version numbers, such as 6.1 and 10.0 etc, combined with build numbers and product types to familiar marketing names, such as Windows 7 and Windows Server 2022.

    Change logs:

    • Added on 10 February 2021
    • Updated March 2024: Added support for Windows 11, Windows Server 2022, and advanced Linux distribution detection
    • Updated March 2026: Big improvements in logic in several methods, including detecting the difference between Win10 and Win 11, plus Windows Server 2025
    Since:
    10 February 2021

      • getOSFamily

        public Platform.OSFamily getOSFamily()
        Returns the broad operating system family, such as Windows, Linux, or Unix, that this specific Platform belongs to.

        This classification is useful for identifying shared characteristics across different distributions or versions, such as POSIX compliance.

        Returns:
        the OSFamily classification

      • fromOSversion

        public static Platform fromOSversion(double osVer,
                                     boolean isServer)
        Searches for a matching Operating System constant based on a numerical version and device role.

        This allows for distinguishing between OS releases that share the same version number but have different roles, such as Windows 10 (10.0, false) and Windows Server 2016 (10.0, true).

        Parameters:
        osVer - the numerical version of the Operating System
        isServer - true if the OS is a server type, or false for workstations
        Returns:
        the matching Platform constant, or UNKNOWN if no match is found

      • fromRealName

        public static Platform fromRealName(java.lang.String osName)
        Searches for a matching Operating System enumeration value based on the familiar marketing name string, such as Windows Server 2008 R2.
        Parameters:
        osName - the Operating System name in its short or abbreviated name format
        Returns:
        an enumeration value if a match is found; otherwise UNKNOWN
